w10_T4_000095: A jewellery workshop keeps its stock in 236 boxes, with 4 strings of beads packed in every box. An apprentice found 4 more strings that had rolled under a bench, and a supplier posted 5 further strings that morning. Every string is built from 4 sections, each section carries 8 beads, and each bead is hand-painted with 6 tiny dots. The workshop pays 900 dollars a month in rent for the studio. How many painted dots are there on the workshop's beads altogether?
w10_T4_000099: Leah had 157 stamps in her album at the start of the summer. Her cousin Tomas gave her 55 from his own collection, and her aunt posted her 32 more, which left Tomas with a far smaller collection than Leah's. A dealer at the town fair then ran an offer that matched every stamp in a collection with an identical one, so Leah came away with 2 times as many stamps as she had brought in. On the way home a neighbour handed her another 77 stamps from an old shoebox. Leah's album index counts single stamps rather than whole sheets. How many stamps are in Leah's album now?
w10_T4_000101: For the school summer fair, 119 gift bags were assembled on Thursday and 18 more on Friday. Each of the bags was filled with 6 sweets from the big tub in the staff room. A teacher then tipped 51 loose sweets into the same tub, and another class donated 66. During the fair itself 592 sweets were handed out to visitors from that tub. The hall has 240 chairs stacked along the back wall. How many sweets are left in the tub?
w10_T4_000108: The print room started Monday morning with 89 folders, and every folder contained 6 sheets of paper. Just before midday a colleague dropped 45 loose sheets into the same tray. During the afternoon 179 sheets were couriered out to the regional offices. In the evening the office manager shredded 29 sheets that carried old addresses. How many sheets are left in the print room?
w10_T4_000115: Sara and Diego build model bridges at their engineering club. Sara's box held 58 wooden rods to start with, she bought 50 more from the craft shop, and Diego handed her 60, which was more than she had bought herself. Each rod in the box can be cut into 5 short pegs for the joints. The club then packed all the pegs equally into 4 storage boxes. The club's inventory is written up in single pegs rather than in full boxes. How many pegs are in one storage box?
w10_T4_000116: Marta planted 57 rows in her allotment with 2 seedlings in every row. Slugs got to 41 of the seedlings and destroyed them. Every seedling that survived went on to produce 6 flowers. Her neighbour Kwame, who tends fewer rows than Marta does, brought her 75 cut flowers for the village show, and the local school added 43 more to the same display. How many flowers are in the show display?
w10_T4_000133: Ines gathered 95 walnuts from the tree at the end of the lane, and her brother Rafael added 40 that he had picked, fewer than Ines had found. They tipped them all together and shared them equally among 5 cloth bags. Ines took one bag home and cracked every walnut in it into 4 pieces. She threw away 11 pieces that had gone mouldy inside the shell. Each remaining piece was then chopped into 4 crumbs for a cake topping. How many crumbs did Ines end up with?
w10_T4_000143: Sofia counted 196 pallets of floor tiles in the warehouse, with 4 crates stacked on every pallet, 8 packs in each crate, and 3 tiles in each pack. Her colleague Bruno carried in 77 loose tiles from the sample room, a far smaller number than Sofia had counted on the pallets. A builder's order then took 11180 tiles out of the warehouse on lorries. The warehouse forklift can lift 900 kilograms at a time. How many tiles are still in the warehouse?
w10_T4_000144: Early on Monday morning the pickers at a tea estate filled 123 baskets, and each basket held 7 kilograms of leaf. A latecomer tipped 8 more kilograms onto the pile before it went into the shed. During the afternoon the factory turned every kilogram of leaf into 7 sealed packets. That evening 2268 packets went out on the first lorry and 673 on the second. A dozen crows sat on the shed roof watching the loading. How many packets are still in the shed?
w10_T4_000146: Yusuf brought 131 conkers to school and gave 113 of them away during morning break. He split the conkers he still had equally among 3 friends. One of those friends, Mira, split her share equally among her 3 younger cousins, so she handed out fewer conkers to each cousin than Yusuf had given to each friend. The youngest cousin already kept 58 conkers of her own in a tin and added her share to them. She then threaded every conker in the tin onto a string with 7 glass beads beside it. How many glass beads did the youngest cousin use?
w10_T4_000151: Early one morning Ana counted 196 sacks of rice in the relief depot, and every sack holds 9 bags. In the late morning her colleague Bruno, who counts more slowly than Ana does, weighed the bags and found that each bag fills 8 cups. During the afternoon the kitchen staff measured that each cup of rice fills 4 small bowls. In the evening the head cook worked out that each bowl feeds 5 children at the shelter. How many children can the depot's rice feed?
w10_T4_000154: The caretaker set out 91 chairs in the village hall on Saturday morning. His colleague Dana carried in 34 more from the store cupboard, fewer than he had set out himself. Before lunch 56 of the chairs were taken outside for a garden class. In the afternoon a hire company delivered 47 extra chairs into the hall. That evening the cleaner wiped every chair in the hall with 8 sprays of polish. How many sprays of polish were used?
w10_T4_000157: Grace's duck farm sent 159 crates of eggs to the packing shed, with 4 boxes in every crate and 3 eggs in every box. A rough journey cracked 783 of the eggs and they were thrown away. Her partner Idris, who keeps fewer ducks than Grace does, set aside another 124 eggs to go under the broody hens instead. How many eggs went on to the market?
w10_T4_000168: Omar's paving yard held 229 pallets of stones, with 5 stones on every pallet. A hard frost cracked 1018 of the stones and they were broken up for hardcore. Every stone that survived was bedded down with 9 dabs of mortar by his apprentice Lena, who lays stones more slowly than Omar does, and a leftover bucket gave her 51 extra dabs along the edging. Each dab of mortar takes 9 grams of cement. A dozen seagulls circled the yard all afternoon. How many grams of cement went into the job?
w10_T4_000169: Nadia poured 119 soap moulds one morning, and each mould produced 6 bars. She added 30 bars left over from an earlier batch to the same crate. Her partner Karl, who pours fewer moulds each week than Nadia, wrapped every bar in the crate in 3 sheets of tissue paper, and a spare roll gave him 68 extra sheets for the shop display. Each sheet of tissue was then stamped with 3 gold logos, and a printer's sample sheet added 52 more logos to the day's count. How many gold logos were counted that day?
w10_T4_000170: On Saturday morning a stationery van was loaded with 142 packs of pens, and each pack contained 4 pens. Before noon a leaking bottle of ink ruined 43 of the pens. In the afternoon 183 pens were dropped off at a school on the ring road. In the evening the driver Nia and her helper Ben divided the pens still in the van equally among 3 corner shops, with Ben carrying more of the boxes inside than Nia did. How many pens did one corner shop receive?
w10_T4_000172: A youth orchestra printed 200 concert flyers and split them equally between its 2 rehearsal halls. The conductor then added 46 spare flyers to the pile in the east hall. Every flyer in the east hall was folded so that it carried 6 raffle coupons. A volunteer named Priya cut 63 further coupons by hand, more than her colleague Sam managed that evening. Before the interval 620 coupons had been sold to the audience. How many coupons are still unsold?
w10_T4_000173: A community radio station had 112 minutes of recorded interviews on file and added 58 minutes from a session held that week. Each minute of interview was transcribed onto 5 index cards by the archive team. The editor then discarded 520 cards that simply repeated material from older tapes. A volunteer typed up 10 further cards, a listener posted in 66, and a neighbouring station donated 45. The station's catalogue is kept in minutes rather than in hours. How many index cards does the station hold now?
w10_T4_000177: Early on Friday morning a paper mill had 213 reels in the yard and took delivery of 53 more before the shift began. Through the morning every reel in the yard was cut down into 8 large sheets. During the afternoon 683 sheets were rejected for creases and sent back to the pulper. In the evening the printers ruled each remaining sheet into 7 columns, and every column was then divided into 7 rows of boxes. A dozen delivery bikes waited at the gate for the night run. How many boxes were ruled in total?
w10_T4_000179: A library trolley held 210 returned books when the staff arrived on Monday. A shelver put 53 of them back on the shelves during the morning, and 4 were pulled off the trolley with broken spines. Over the rest of the week readers returned 40 more books to the trolley, a school dropped off 68, and a house clearance donated 80. The library opens for 9 hours a day in the summer. How many books are sitting on the trolley now?
w10_T4_000181: Early on Saturday morning Ines picked 122 plums from the tree behind her house and kept half of them, sending the rest round to her neighbour. Before lunch she used 33 of her own plums to make a pot of jam. In the early afternoon a friend arrived with 27 plums from his garden for her. Later that afternoon she sold 47 plums at the roadside table by the gate. In the evening her daughter came home with 5 more from the market. The price card on the roadside table is written in cents rather than dollars. How many plums does Ines have at the end of the day?
w10_T4_000182: A cycle shop's workshop had 79 inner tubes on the rack, and a wholesaler's van delivered 64 more. The wholesaler then recalled 111 tubes because of a faulty valve batch. The tubes that were left were split equally between the shop's 2 branches. The high street branch used 10 of its tubes on repairs that week and afterwards received 73 more from a closing-down sale down the road. The shop's stock sheet counts single tubes rather than sealed cartons. How many inner tubes does the high street branch have?
w10_T4_000183: The village hall's summer raffle sold 130 tickets on Monday. Sales carried on with 23 tickets on Tuesday and 57 on Wednesday. Thursday brought in 45 tickets, and the last day, Friday, added 40. A dozen volunteers took turns running the stall by the door. How many raffle tickets were sold over the whole week?
w10_T4_000185: A small dairy pressed 63 rounds of cheese for the weekend market, and each round was cut into 6 wedges. A neighbouring dairy sent over 47 wedges to be sold on the same stall. Every wedge was then sliced into 7 portions for the tasting counter. Customers ate 1798 portions on Saturday and 659 on Sunday, and 99 portions were thrown away at the end of the weekend. The stall's awning is 5 metres wide. How many portions are left on the counter?
w10_T4_000187: On Tuesday morning the scout hut's water butt held 68 litres, and a light shower before breakfast added 5 litres to it. During the afternoon the gardeners drew off 50 litres for the vegetable beds. In the early evening the caretaker filled a second butt so that it held exactly as much as the first, making the site's store 2 times what the first butt held. Overnight another matching pair of butts was filled, so the site's store became 2 times the evening figure. The site log is kept in litres rather than in cubic metres. How many litres are stored on the site now?
